items.t: Navitas Sinks 18% in a Week as Nvidia’s CEO Exit Rattles Its AI Pitch: “Poised to Triple”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysNavitas shares fell 18% in a week as AI chip stocks sold off after NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigned, with no bad news from Navitas itself. Navitas’s AI growth story depends on NVIDIA moving data centers to 800-volt power.
